title: TaskCompleted
description: A task passed its checks; its branch is pushed. Topic hotl.run; subject and key: the run id. Producer: Orchestrator. Main consumers: Knowledge graph.

filesChanged.description: Paths the task's commits changed, relative to the repo root (since v0.10.0).

tokens.description: Tokens the task used over all its attempts and checks (since v0.10.0).
